ns2:section.sectionText: Russ. lit. & lang., 11th-17th centuries (Russ 517) Whatever your motivation, you may want to read Old and Middle Russian literary texts, such as chronicles, legends, biographies, wars, murders, weird tales, funny stories, erotic adventures, conspiracies, torture, speeches, you name it. All those genres are contained in Gudzii's anthology. Questions? -- Ask instructor S. P. Hill <S-HILL4@ILLINOIS.EDU>
